responsibility: This scheduling description models UltraSPARC-III as a quad-issue but less slot-constrained processor than UltraSPARC-I/II. It defines reservations for symmetric integer units, multiply/divide, delayed loads, branches, calls, floating-point operations, and VIS instructions, along with key bypasses, giving the scheduler a generation-specific UltraSPARC-III timing model separate from ultra1_2.md.
